objective: One finite development-only test of a common scalar Treasury location correction whose raw-cell variogram is invariant; no new reserve or official upload.
baseline: Exact submitted v2, frozen forecast/core and horizon/return helpers.
scope: Only grids composed entirely of known daily additive UST maturity level/yield targets under current variogram scoring. Unsupported, mixed, monthly, return, FX or energy-score grids preserve exact v2. Daily support explicitly requires median_calendar_step<=3 calendar days; slower observations fall back exactly.
one_mechanism: From exact v2 evidence compute cell discrepancies d=actualGaussianDrawShare*(anchor-GaussianMean). Let g=median(d), bounded to +/-0.25 times smallest finite positive Gaussian horizon SD. Apply g identically to every asset/horizon of every complete joint draw, only if fixed input-resolved marginal/tail gate admits. No volatility/DNS/text/weight model added.
invariant: For raw scored cells (x_i+g)-(x_j+g)=x_i-x_j: pairwise draw differences and p=.5 variogram invariant up to floating rounding. This does not preserve energy, marginal or tail scores, or predict accuracy.

gate.origin_policy: Most recent complete nonoverlapping fully resolved old windows of exact outer targetgrid; each old targetdate<=currentasof and oldpanels/text cutoff at oldorigin, gap-safe windows. No nested candidate gate: compare exact v2 and ungated scalar correction at each oldorigin.
gate.admission: Equal-window mean input-normalized marginal fairCRPS <=0.98*v2 and mean normalized fourquantile pinball <=v2. No fitted weight/threshold/grid; no outertargets. Variogram numerical equality required. Exactfallback if insufficient windows or guard fails.
gate.normalization: Frozen documented Gaussian M0 expected-loss formulas from each oldorigin input-only Gaussian300 parameters. Gate uses separate marginal/tail means without clip, not composite ranking. Record allquantile/horizon diagnostics but do not fit gates after outcomes. Exactoneunit/oneoldwindow means; flatasset-major horizon-minor cells. Gaussian mean/covariance from sameoldv2forecast; normalizers marginal/tail only, joint invariantdiagnostic. Uniform8windows weights.
gate.resources: Single numerical thread, existing numpy/pandas/scipy only. One v2 old forecast per8windows; scalar arm uses deterministic translation. No model/network/install/personal compute. No taskID-dependent behavior.
gate.origin_lattice: Zero-based position in complete synchronized targetasset dateindex, scanned mostrecentbackward; firstobserveddate>=oldorigin+BDay(h) and >oldorigin, exactlysamecalendar mapping as outerevaluator. Maxalltargetdate<=currentasof; earlier maxdate<lateracceptedorigin. Gaplimit max(10*preorigin median daygap,5). No row-count horizon substitution. Minimum synchronized zero-based origin position251 includes252 observed rows; each targetasset separately has>=252 observations.
gate.gap_safe_definition: Minimum252 means preorigin observed values perasset; not252consecutive gap-free observations. Exact v2.safe_changes excludes every individual preorigin long gap when estimating increments. Old origin→alltarget intervals additionally satisfy fixed gap guard. No whole-history rejection is added.
gate.daily_grid_semantics: Canonical current GridSpec horizon keys are positive integer businessdays; target_date is sealed reference annotation and not scoringgrid input. For daily candidate require exact v2 effective_panel_steps==declaredhorizons. Ignore stale date hints/outer forecast_spec date hints; stripped old card plus freshly constructed asset/horizon spec govern old daily calls. Only monthly core resolves explicit periods, which always falls back in V8.

synthetic_falsification.stop_rule: Reject without development if any temporal/invariant/error failure or any synthetic regime normalized mean score >1.05*v2. Synthetic results are falsification evidence, not real-data competitiveness.
synthetic_falsification.index_semantics: 0basedoriginrow1300; observedhistoryrows0..1300inclusive1301; yroworigin+h for 21/63BD completecalendar. 1500totalrows includingfuturetruth; panels cut atorigin before runtime.
synthetic_falsification.drift_definition: stable_zero_drift d=0; persistent_common_drift allrows d=.001; drift_reversal d=.001 for row<1250 then -.001; volatility_jump d=0 and SD.03 before1250 then .09. SameGaussianz pertruthseed acrossregimes; rateanchors3,5.

development.origin_policy: Same outcome-independent eligible/time-separated atmost2origin roster as V7 consumeddevelopment; no freshreserve, no newdates claim.
development.primary: Ratio of equalunit mean reconstructed documentedM0 normalized composite clip8 vs exactv2; rawcomponents, unclipped, perquantile/perhorizon and family diagnostics separately.
development.selection: No arm/parameter search. One frozen candidate, synthetic first then atmostone train+validation run if not falsified; preserve allerrors/results. Any needed sourcefix gets preserved predecessor/newfreeze, no outcome tuning.
development.useful_development_evidence: Aim >=2%validation gain, no trainregression, no family/component >1.05, zeroerrors/invariantfailures and independently reviewed cost. Consumedpanels/previousoutcomes mean no independentstatistical or officialrank claim.

exposure: All contest numericpanels/train/validation are consumed through V2–V7. V7 reserve2002–2004 and externalpre2000 alreadyconsumed. No further reserve or external data acquisition in this study.
official_feedback: Existing V2 official feedback last known pending. No V8 upload; root prioritization and real useful evidence required, quotas are upper bounds.
scalar_finite_guard: Every declared Gaussian mean/covariance diagonal/anchor finite and every cell horizon SD>0; any invalid cell exactfallback, no dropping cell from bound. Gaussian covariance symmetry and positive semidefiniteness also checked using documented M0 tolerance1e-12; malformed/empty asset grid or drawcount fallback.

numerical_invariance_tolerance.control_extreme_scale: Report finite numerical rounding; never loosen fixed tolerances after outcomes.

partial_failure_policy: Owner/independent controls frozen before execution. Synthetic writes append-only allarm-row/check/case journals while running, retains errors among all288 declared rows and all48truthpaths, never computes survivor-only ratios. Any control or synthetic failure disallows development. Evaluation has fixed train/validation labels, append-only records and preserves failures.
